name: aethel-agent-factory
description: Repository containing Aethelred Protocol (decentralized AI) and Agent Factory MVP (autonomous trading agents) - awaiting integration

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd agent-factory-mvp && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:rust && npm run build:contracts
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:contracts
scripts.deploy:agent-factory: cd agent-factory-mvp && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy_and_write.js --network localhost
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:aethelred && npm run deploy:agent-factory
scripts.start:aethelred-node: cd aethelred && cargo run --bin aethelred-node -- run executor
scripts.monitor: cd agent-factory-mvp && npx hardhat run scripts/monitor_agent.js --network localhost
scripts.dev:setup: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.integration:test: npm run test && cd agent-factory-mvp && npx hardhat run scripts/test_trading.js --network localhost
scripts.clean: cd aethelred && cargo clean && cd ../agent-factory-mvp && rm -rf artifacts cache
scripts.lint: cd aethelred && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -- -D warnings
scripts.mint:agent: cd agent-factory-mvp && npx hardhat mint --name "TEST_AGENT" --strategyid 1 --network localhost

author: Aethel Team
